hook_composition.label: watch comparison selfie starter
hook_composition.camera_height: handheld phone selfie height, slightly above eye line
hook_composition.lens_feel: front-camera TikTok creator selfie with natural wide phone perspective
hook_composition.subject_scale: runner face, upper torso, and watch-side forearm fill 45-60% of frame without blocking text
hook_composition.face_visibility: face visible like a real runner selfie, natural and slightly imperfect
hook_composition.movement_state: runner holding the phone before or after a run with the watch-side wrist naturally visible in frame
hook_composition.negative_space_zone: upper side sky, trail, forest, lake, or mountain background away from face and watch
hook_composition.background_depth: selected route world stays visible behind the selfie so it is not a plain portrait
hook_composition.watch_comparison_rule: For watch-comparison hooks only, the selected watch can be clearly visible in the lower foreground of the selfie, but the image must remain a runner selfie, not a wrist-only macro close-up. No readable screen UI, no brand logo, no fake watch ad pose, and no watch-checking pose.
hook_composition.direction: start watch-comparison decks with a realistic runner selfie where the running watch is clearly visible near the lower foreground, but never as a wrist-only close-up; keep the selected route world visible behind him
hook_composition.rotation_policy: Watch-comparison decks start with a watch-and-selfie hook frame before rotating the supporting visual world.
hook_composition.composition_priority: Watch-comparison selfie starter overrides the avatar variation angle when they conflict.

schema_prompt_template: photorealistic runner post-run in {scene}, thoughtful expression, clean text space, no text
production_rules: Every slideshow has an explicit emotion, one Images 2.0 hook, one generated avatar world, and one final CTA.
Slide hook and slides 1-6 should use the source-backed TikTok slideshow text bank before any generic AI wording.
Do not generate all slideshow images in one Images 2.0 request.
Do not bake overlay text into the image.
Keep the full deck in one visual world and one lighting family.
For the hook image, reference-image background is non-transferable; the generated background must match visual_world.
Keep one primary visual world per slideshow; lake worlds may include mountains or hills as background context.
Use Supabase/curated library assets for slides 2 through the CTA slide.
Composite all text locally with Sharp/Canvas.
